name: 寒冰魔像
subject: An ICE GOLEM, full squat body of rough opaque pale turquoise glacier slabs, frost-white bevels, two heavy arms and two jointed legs, a small deep sapphire core; jagged ice shoulder plates.

name: 冰晶元素
subject: An ice elemental with the existing crystal head and arms; a compact irregular cluster of overlapping lower crystal facets, short central broken end, no legs or feet. Hover locomotion.

name: 骷髏弓箭手
subject: A full-body SKELETON ARCHER, weathered ivory bones, complete ribcage pelvis and two legs, faded indigo hood and short waist cloth, small rusty recurved bow held with both bony hands and a few arrows in a quiver.

name: 寒冰龍王
subject: An ICE DRAGON KING, a complete compact western dragon with silver-blue scales, ivory horns, two folded or articulated wings, four clawed legs and a full curled tail; pale cyan ice fins, readable ordinary enemy sprite.
